note: Qualitative synthesis of the provided report. Scores are analytical judgment, not investment advice or a certified claim.

opportunities.name: Epitope / neoantigen SaMD and semi-personalized panels
opportunities.market: Cross-indication demand across NGS, TCR screening and shared-antigen platforms
opportunities.unit_economics: Software/diagnostic margins; semi-personalized mRNA ~$80K COGS vs ~$30K off-the-shelf
opportunities.barriers: DTU commercial licensing; FDA SaMD / EU IVDR; clinical validation of the selection rule
opportunities.earning_potential: Highest capital efficiency: captures oncology, HBV and autoimmunity value without N=1 GMP suites
opportunities.why: The certificate itself is the product. The engine can price a selection claim without manufacturing a batch.

opportunities.name: Chronic HBV functional cure and therapeutic vaccines
opportunities.market: >240M patients globally; ~80% remain uncured even after bepirovirsen approval (Oct 2026)
opportunities.unit_economics: Off-the-shelf mRNA/peptide/ASO batch scale; biologic gross margins approaching >90%
opportunities.barriers: Must improve on bepirovirsen's 19–20% finite cure rate or unlock cirrhotic / HIV-HDV co-infected subgroups
opportunities.earning_potential: Highest volume upside; massive chronic prevalence with a validated finite-cure precedent
opportunities.why: Epitope discovery is a real differentiator, and the endpoint is finite and measurable.

opportunities.name: Autoimmune inverse vaccines and orphan-first resets
opportunities.market: Large chronic populations seeking freedom from lifelong immunosuppressants; celiac, SPS, MS, T1D, gMG
opportunities.unit_economics: Ex vivo CAR-T faces cell COGS (~56% GM benchmark); in vivo liver-targeted / mRNA inverse vaccines retain biologic margins
opportunities.barriers: Durable antigen-specific tolerance in Phase 2/3; avoiding CAR-T safety events
opportunities.earning_potential: Highest M&A/licensing demand: 106 autoimmune deals in 2025, second only to oncology
opportunities.why: The deal market is paying for validated tolerance, not for another immunosuppressant.

opportunities.name: De novo N=1 personalized cancer vaccines
opportunities.market: High-incidence adjuvant solid tumours: melanoma, NSCLC, PDAC
opportunities.unit_economics: >$300K estimated COGS; 4–8 week vein-to-vein; scale-out GMP suites; ~56% cell-therapy margin benchmark
opportunities.barriers: Must outperform active checkpoint comparators in 1,100+ patient trials and share revenue with checkpoint owners
opportunities.earning_potential: Lowest standalone return for new entrants without Big Pharma co-development
opportunities.why: The clinical benchmark is real, but the manufacturing and comparator economics are brutal.
